about: The data schema of a backlog item without a team, as the code defines it today (src/shared/item-definition.js; the command `backlog fields` prints the same table). One item is one JSON file. This file is a template for correction: edit a key, its type, its default, who sets it or its meaning, or delete a key that should not exist. Nothing reads this file.

file.path: .backlog/<owner>/<name>/phases/<slug>.json for an open item and .backlog/<owner>/<name>/archive/<slug>.json for an archived one, inside the repository or inside a separate backlog repository (a storage setting)
file.note: an archived item is an item whose file is in the archive folder; no key says so

seq.meaning: The item's number in this repository, never reused

slug.meaning: The name an item is addressed by in every command

name.meaning: A short title of the item

team.set_by: backlog team new, a rule of the team, backlog team migrate
team.meaning: The team that owns the item. Absent for an item without a team. An item with this key takes its fields from its team's item definition in the team file, not from the list below

repository.meaning: The repository the item belongs to

branch.meaning: The branch the item belongs to

updated.default: the time of the last change

updated_by.default: the agent named, else the user of the configuration

status.set_by: backlog new --status, backlog update --status, backlog update --claim and --release, backlog done
status.meaning: Where the item is, a free word stored exactly as typed; the finished words are closed, done and archived

objective.meaning: The result the item delivers, one line

summary.meaning: Several sentences about what the item is for; it routes new work to the right item

location.meaning: Free text: where the work is

commit.default: the commit of HEAD at creation
commit.meaning: The commit the work has reached

severity.meaning: A critical item is placed first

owner.meaning: The agent working on the item; outside a team, the user the item belongs to

owned_since.meaning: When the agent took the item; empty while nobody holds it

depends_on.meaning: The items that must be finished first

parent.meaning: The item this one was split from

estimate_min.meaning: Minutes of work, a whole number

chunk.meaning: Small pieces of work any member does between items

size_score.meaning: A whole number that sizes the item

fields_note: A field that was never given is left out of the file (the example below has no parent, layer, chunk, size_score or completed) and reads as its default.

body.default: the title, the objective and the description given at creation
body.meaning: The description of the item and the records appended to it

history.type: list of entries, one per command that changed the item

entry.session: the session id, when one was given
entry.step: the command or the team step

example_written_by_the_command.command: backlog new --title "Add the login form" --objective "People can sign in" --depends-on none --estimate 40 --complexity low
example_written_by_the_command.note: the file this command writes on the current head, with the person and the commit id replaced

item.name: Add the login form
item.body:
# Phase 001 — Add the login form

**Objective:** People can sign in


## Definition of done
